name: Silas the Informant
description: A wiry man with shifty eyes who seems to know everything happening in Gearhaven's underworld. For the right price, he'll tell you what you need to know.

initial_greeting.text: *slides into seat across from you* Detective. Heard you're asking questions about Steamwright. Dangerous questions. Information like that... has a price.

choices.text: Tell me what you know or I'll arrest you.

negotiate.text: Fifty crowns. And that's a discount, considering what I know could get me killed. The Cog and Key don't like loose ends.

paid.text: *pockets coins* Smart. Steamwright stumbled onto something big. Secret society running the city—politicians, factory owners, even cops. They meet in a ritual chamber under the old warehouses. Password changes weekly, but I heard this week's is 'Eternal Mechanism'. Good luck, Detective. You'll need it.

refused.text: Your funeral. Literally. Good luck solving this one alone.

threat.text: On what charge? I'm just a humble citizen enjoying a drink. Besides, arresting me won't get you the information. But paying me will.
